protocol.initialization: paired within each panel; fixed width-6 arm shares width-2 prefix and adds four seeded features
protocol.operator_loss: full identity-basis relative squared Frobenius loss; same target and fit/heldout IDs across arms
protocol.spectral_baseline: unconstrained degree-1/degree-4 Chebyshev fit on fitting panels; relevant strong baseline only for spectral_heat target
protocol.local_baseline: fixed degree-2 centered local feature operator basis by weighted linear least squares; a target-matched synthetic baseline, not the selected physical strong baseline
protocol.limitations: 3 panels per cell; no physical gauge ensemble, inferential interval, GPU timing, or production contract; optimizer seconds exclude input/target setup and postchecks
